summary: This RFC defines a Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588-2019) profile for IPv4 or IPv6 enterprise networks. It uses the end-to-end delay measurement mechanism and allows both multicast and unicast Delay Request and Delay Response messages, so clocks across an enterprise can be synchronized in a common way.

eli5.summary: Lots of clocks in a building need to show the same time exactly. This tells them which of the possible ways of asking and answering to use so they agree.

questions: precision time protocol multicast and unicast profile
